weather.title: Погода с Мультиком
weather.description: Sixteen city weather cards, approximately 192 seconds, including cities across western Russia, Siberia and the Far East. Global forecast from MET Norway with wttr.in fallback; if both providers are unavailable, an explicitly labelled no-data card is used. Provider attribution is shown on each forecast card.

note: The continuous playlist plays six original educational programmes, then a weather segment of approximately 192 seconds with 16 Russian cities, and repeats. Weather forecasts use MET Norway as the primary source and wttr.in as a fallback; if both are unavailable, the channel shows a clearly labelled no-data card. This is a repeating cycle, not a separate daily start at a fixed time. Live status is determined by actual HLS segment progress and player playback.

maintenance.reference: Daily maintenance window aligned to Moscow broadcast time
